newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CULLINAN TERMINATES UNIT DISPOSAL AGREEMENT.
newsitem.headline: CULLINAN TERMINATES UNIT DISPOSAL AGREEMENT.

text.p: Cullinan Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that an agreement with a purchaser of Cullinan's electrical division had been terminated and Cullinan was pursuing other alternatives for the disposal.

"On December 4 1996 shareholders were informed that the purchaser of the electrical division had advised Cullinan that, for reasons not previously disclosed to Cullinan which were unrelated to the electrical division, there would be a delay in obtaining the board resolution required to ratify the agreement of sale.

"The purchaser has now informed Cullinan that this resolution cannot be obtained within the timeframe incorporated in the agreement. Accordingly the agreement has been terminated and Cullinan is actively pursuing other alternatives," it said.
It said that shareholders would be advised further when "concrete progress" had been made.
